definitions.explanation: The fleshy part of the body that one sits on.

examples.japanese: お{尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{尻|しり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧。
⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{座|すわ}っていたら→座る：00757_suwaru⟧お{尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痺|しび}れた→痺れる：06814_shibireru⟧。
examples.english: My bottom went numb from sitting for a long time.

notes:
お{尻|しり} is the standard word for buttocks in everyday Japanese.

REGISTER:
The お prefix makes this a polite form. The plain form ⟦{尻|しり}→尻：03684_shiri⟧ exists but sounds rougher. お{尻|しり} is appropriate in most situations.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{尻|しり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧: to wipe one's bottom
- お{尻|しり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧: to spank
- お{尻|しり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: my bottom hurts
- お{尻|しり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to be in a tight spot (lit. fire on one's rear)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{尻|しり}→尻：03684_shiri⟧: plain form (rougher)
- ⟦{臀部|でんぶ}→臀部：23616_denbu⟧: medical/formal term
